definition.final_reward_page_score: As recorded by rollout.py: the environment's last returned reward. Upstream web_agent_text_env.py sets self.reward=search_max on search pages (line 478) and maxr on item pages (line 558); only the purchase path (line 630) yields the task score. Therefore this is a page-match score, NOT the task reward.
definition.terminal_reward: reward if done else 0.0 -- the task-level outcome. Zero when the episode never purchased.
definition.episode_seconds: Per-episode wall time recorded inside rollout.py (excludes model load).

timing_note: sum_episode_seconds is the sum of the JSONL per-episode 'seconds' fields. The 65 s figure quoted earlier was outer shell wall-clock between two date calls and therefore ALSO includes model loading and process startup; it is not the episode time.
wilson_note: rollout-3val-summary.json was produced by the pre-PR#8 'summarize'. Its success_rate_wilson_95 lower bound is 5.551115123125783e-17, a floating-point artifact of 0.0; it should read 0.0. That file also lacks purchase_terminated / terminal_reward fields. It must be regenerated with 'evaluate' after PR #8 merges. This supplement is derived independently from the raw JSONL and is NOT a substitute for the evaluator output.
